scripts.e2e: bash tests/e2e/stack.sh up && bun tests/e2e/ui.ts; s=$?; bash tests/e2e/stack.sh down; exit $s
scripts.db:test:up: docker start hbr-test-pg >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker run -d --name hbr-test-pg -p 127.0.0.1:55432:5432 -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres --tmpfs /var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:17-alpine -c max_connections=400 -c fsync=off; i=0; until docker exec hbr-test-pg psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -tAc "select 1" >/dev/null 2>&1; do i=$((i+1)); [ $i -gt 100 ] && { echo "hbr-test-pg not ready" >&2; exit 1; }; sleep 0.3; done
